title: 第十三章 审问
content_zh:
许七安看着他的背影，并不怎么乐观。
时隔多日，取证太难了。
“验不了指纹，想取证几乎不可能。鞋印肯定不可能是张献自己的....嗯，刨除这些，还有什么手段适用这个时代，能帮助破案的....”他搜刮肚肠的想办法。
......
“这帮无能的胥吏，捞油水的时候一个个精明的跟猴似的，石头都能榨出油水。到了办正事，全是无能的狗辈。”
县令老爷正在内堂发火，命案本就是大案，偏死者还与给事中的徐大人沾亲带故。
给事中当差的是什么人？
是自诩清流的言官，逮谁咬谁的疯狗，看谁不顺眼就上书弹劾，
留着山羊须，面容清瘦的徐主簿陪在一旁，笑呵呵道：“大人再这么逼迫下去，他们得摸鱼了。”
都是老油条，手底下的胥吏打什么注意，长官门儿清。
论起官场上的骚操作，胥吏最多就是小学生水平，段位最高的在庙堂，其次是封疆大吏。
“摸鱼？”朱县令哼一声：“往日里也就罢了，京察在即，回头被人以屈打成招为由弹劾，本官如何自处？”
正说着，急促的脚步声传来，王捕头进了内堂，跨过门槛后停下，态度恭敬，语气中充斥着兴奋：“大人，张氏一案，小人已经有眉目了，请大人发一份牌票，小人这就拿人去。”
朱县令和徐主簿相视一眼，前者冷笑，后者露出果然如此的笑容。
见两人神色不对，王捕头催促道：“大人？时不可待啊。”
朱县令拍了一下桌子，骂道：“蠢货，这都什么时候了，还想着摸鱼。你是猪脑子吗。”
屈打成招在平日里是可以用的，但这里有个问题。
犯人招供后，供词和卷宗要上交刑部，由刑部核实后，给出判决。
年底就京察了，京城官场气氛紧张，大家一边收拾自己的尾巴，一边又相互监视，恨不得抓住政敌的马脚。
这是说翻案就翻案的时期。

王捕头急忙辩解：“大人误会了，小人是真的有把握抓住真凶，绝非摸鱼。请大人相信我。”
你什么水平，本官不知道么.....朱县令对此并不放心，瞅了老王一眼：“你仔细说说。”
王捕头心说，也到我人前显圣的时候了。
“大人，且听我细细道来，张氏一案中存在诸多疑点.....”
老王把许七安的推断，原原本本的复刻一遍，说给两位大人听。
朱县令一开始面带冷笑，听着听着，腰杆不自觉的挺直。到最后，一发不言，却满脸严肃。
他在思考。
“妙啊！”徐主簿一击掌，‘啪’的响亮，显得非常亢奋：“抽丝剥茧，调理清晰，竟能从这些不起眼的细节中推测出案件始末。刑部的老手也不过如此了。”
虽说还有待查证！
但这套推理，无疑给一头雾水的县衙众人指明了方向。
王捕头笑道：“大家过奖了。”
朱县令嗤笑一声：“说说，谁教你的。”
王捕头略一沉思，按下了揽功的心思，如实道：“快手许七安。”
快手不是直播平台，许七安也不是主播，快手是快班胥吏的称呼，也叫捕快。
许七安....朱县令率先反应过来：“是他啊。”
朱县令和许平志喝过几次酒，有几分交情，前些年许平志花了二十两白银，替侄儿要了快手这个肥差。
在大奉朝，吏员的职位，是可以传给儿子的。
稳如老狗的金饭碗。
“是他就没错了。”朱县令笑了。
徐主簿目光一闪，想到了牵连许家的税银案，立刻问：“您这话怎么说？”

王捕头亦侧耳倾听。
朱县令笑了笑：“税银被劫案闹的满城风雨，许家首当其冲，本该被问责，你们可知为何许家能脱罪？”
王捕头当即道：“听说是御刀卫的许大人协助办案有功，圣上宽容，免了他的罪过。”
这是他刚才听许七安说的。
徐主簿瞄了眼朱县令的神色，试探道：“此案有什么内幕不成。”
税银失踪案的详情，徐主簿的段位还接触不到，但朱县令是长乐县的父母官，虽说在京城这种权贵云集之地，只是个弟弟。
但背后没靠山是坐不稳这个位置的。
朱县令嗤了一声：“许平志只是个粗鄙武夫，此案他不过是个替罪羊....”忽然顿住，似是不想透露过多，转而道：“真正让许家翻身的不是他。”
“是谁！”王捕头下意识的问。
徐主簿心里闪过了答案，等着朱县令的后续。
“是许七安，是他解开了税银案的真相，此事有记在卷宗上，本官一位同年就在京兆府当差。”朱县令道：“子代父过，父债子偿，他虽是个侄儿，但道理是一样的。”
徐主簿倒抽一口凉气：“案发后，许七安应该关在府衙大牢，他是怎么做到的。”
朱县令沉吟道：“我本来也觉得不可思议，但现在想明白了。”
徐主簿同样想到了，难以置信：“仅凭卷宗？！”
仅凭卷宗....王捕头脑子都懵了，这类官场秘闻倒是偶尔能听头顶的三位官老爷说起。
他难以置信的是税银被劫案是许七安从中发挥了巨大的能量，解救了许家。
王捕头心说，这不对啊，没道理啊。
当初这小子初来乍到，性格憨实倔强，只会闷头做事，是真正的愣头青。
这么个愣头青，怎么转眼间就断案如神了。
......

王捕头领了牌票返回休息室时，许七安趴在桌上睡着了。他昨晚乱七八糟的事儿想了太多，三更以后才睡。
旁人伸手去推许七安，王捕头立刻拦住，压低声音：“让他睡吧。”
随手挑了两个人，“你们跟我去一趟张宅。”
三位快手，带上各自的白役，总共九个人，疾步离开长乐县衙。
白役是临时工，属于徭役的一种，由老百姓组成，没有工资，不包吃不包住。
但也有很良心的地方：他们不用背锅。
许七安被“威武”的声音惊醒，擦了擦嘴角的口水，走向县衙大堂。
估摸着人已经逮回来了，县令正在堂前审讯。
公堂上，朱县令高居公案之后，左右是堂事和跟丁。
公案之下，左右两侧立着三班衙役，中间跪着两人，一个穿绣云纹青衣的年轻人，另一位是穿紫色罗裙的美貌妇人。
妇人神色惊恐不安，年轻人则相对镇定。
“啪！”
朱县令怒拍惊堂木，朗声道：“堂下何人！”
妇人下意识看了眼年轻人，年轻人给了她一个镇定的眼神，挺直腰杆：“草民张献。”
妇人细声细气道：“民妇杨珍珍。”
朱县令喝道：“你二人是如何杀死张有瑞，从实招来！”
妇人吓的一颤，长长的睫毛抖动，面露惶恐。
年轻人张献大惊：“大人何出此言，草民怎么会杀害生父。”
朱县令问道：“事发时，你在何处？”
“我在书房。”

“为何不与妻子同塌？”
“草民在看账目。”
“可有人证。”
“深更半夜，哪来的人证。”
张献的回答条理清晰，不慌不乱，要么问心无愧，要么早就打好腹稿。
根据自己的逻辑推理，许七安偏向后一个可能。
他虽然没有不在场证明，但同样没有证据证明他杀人，推理归推理，如果没有切实的证据，疑罪从无.....
县令转而看向妇人，道：“张杨氏，本官问你，你与张有瑞成亲十年，无所出。为何如今又有了身孕？老实交代，是不是你与继子苟且，谋杀亲夫。”
张杨氏吓了一跳，哭道：“大人，民妇冤枉，民妇身子不好，近些年日日调理，好不容易怀上丈夫骨肉，大人怎么能凭此冤枉民妇谋杀亲夫。”
嘤嘤嘤的哭了起来。
这样审怎么可能审出真相，许七安遥望水灵妇人片刻，心里一动，有了个不错的主意。
content_en:
Xu Qian looked at his back and was not very optimistic.
After many days, it was too difficult to obtain evidence.
"Without fingerprints, it's almost impossible to collect evidence. The shoe prints definitely can't be Zhang Xian's... Well, apart from these, is there any other method that is suitable for this era and can help solve the case..." He searched for a way to find a way.
...
"This bunch of incompetent subordinates are as shrewd as monkeys when it comes to fishing for money. They can squeeze oil out of stones. But when it comes to doing business, they are all incompetent dogs."
The county magistrate was angry in the inner hall. The murder was a serious case, but the deceased was related to Mr. Xu who was involved in the incident.
Who was responsible for the incident?
He is a self-proclaimed official who bites anyone, and writes letters of impeachment to anyone he dislikes.
Mr. Xu, who had a goatee and a thin face, accompanied him and said with a smile: "If you continue to force me like this, they will have to fish."
They are all old fools, why should they pay attention to the subordinates under them? The superior officer has a clear door.
When it comes to officialdom, the most subordinate officials are at the level of primary school students. The highest ranking officials are in the temple, followed by the feudal officials.
"Fishing?" Magistrate Zhu snorted: "That's enough in the past. The Beijing police are about to come, and I will be impeached on the grounds that I was beaten into a trick. How will I handle myself?"
Just as he was talking, the sound of rapid footsteps came. Wang entered the inner hall, crossed the threshold and stopped. His attitude was respectful and his tone was full of excitement: "Sir, the villain has already figured out Zhang's case. Please send me a ticket, and I will take the person right now."
Magistrate Zhu and Master Xu looked at each other, the former sneered, and the latter smiled as expected.
Seeing that the two people looked wrong, Wang Captou urged: "Sir? Time can't wait."
County Magistrate Zhu slapped the table and cursed: "Idiot, how long has it been now and you still want to fish? Are you a pig?"
Subduing a move can be used on a daily basis, but there is a problem here.
After the prisoner confesses, the confession and the file must be submitted to the Ministry of Punishment, which will verify and issue a verdict.
The Beijing inspection was held at the end of the year, and the official atmosphere in the capital was tense. While everyone was cleaning up their own tails, they were also monitoring each other, eager to catch the political opponents.
This is a period when the verdict is overturned.
Wang Captou hurriedly defended: "My lord, I have misunderstood. I am really sure of catching the real culprit, and I am definitely not taking advantage of him. Please believe me."
Don't I know what your level is... Magistrate Zhu was not at ease about this and glanced at Lao Wang: "Please tell me carefully."
Wang Qatou thought, "It's time for me to appear as a saint in front of my people."
"Sir, please listen to me in detail. There are many doubts in Zhang's case..."
Lao Wang reproduced Xu Qi'an's deductions exactly as they were, and told them to the two adults.
Magistrate Zhu had a sneer on his face at first, but as he listened, his waist straightened unconsciously. In the end, he said nothing but looked serious.
He is thinking.
"Wonderful!" Mr. Xu gave a high-five with a loud 'pop', and looked very excited: "I peeled off the cocoons and made it clear. I can actually deduce the whole story of the case from these inconspicuous details. The veterans of the Criminal Department are no more than that."
Although it remains to be verified!
But this set of reasoning undoubtedly pointed the way to the confused county government officials.
Wang Captou smiled and said, "Thank you for your praise."
Magistrate Zhu sneered: "Tell me, who taught you."
Wang Captou thought for a moment, then suppressed his intention to take the credit, and said truthfully: "Kuaishou Xu Qi'an."
Kuaishou is not a live broadcast platform, and Xu Qi'an is not an anchor. Kuaishou is the name of Kuaishou's subordinates, also called catchers.
Xu Qian... Magistrate Zhu was the first to react: "It's him."
Magistrate Zhu and Xu Pingzhi drank several times and had a certain friendship. A few years ago, Xu Pingzhi spent twenty taels of silver to get the lucrative job of Kuaishou for his nephew.
In the Dafeng Dynasty, official positions could be passed on to sons.
As steady as an old dogGolden rice bowl.
"That's right if it's him." Magistrate Zhu smiled.
Master Xu's eyes flashed, and he thought of the tax and bank case involving the Xu family, and immediately asked: "What do you say?"
Wang Captou also listened attentively.
Magistrate Zhu smiled: "The robbery of the tax bank caused a storm in the city. The Xu family was the first to bear the brunt. They should have been held accountable. Do you know why the Xu family was able to get away with it?"
Wang Captou immediately said: "I heard that Mr. Xu from the Imperial Sword Guard helped handle the case. The Holy Spirit was merciful and exempted him from his sin."
This is what he heard Xu Qian say just now.
Chief Xu glanced at Magistrate Zhu's expression and said tentatively: "Is there any inside story in this case?"
The details of the missing tax case were not yet accessible to Master Xu’s rank, but Magistrate Zhu was the parent official of Changle County, although he was just a younger brother in a place like the capital where powerful people gathered.
But it is impossible to hold this position without a backer.
County Magistrate Zhu sneered: "Xu Pingzhi is just a vulgar warrior, and he is just a scapegoat in this case..." He suddenly paused, as if he didn't want to reveal too much, and then said: "He was not the one who really turned the Xu family around."
"Who is it?" Wang Captou asked subconsciously.
The answer flashed through Master Xu's mind, waiting for Magistrate Zhu's follow-up.
"It's Xu Qian, he was the one who solved the truth about the tax and bank case. This matter is recorded in the files. One of my officers worked in Jingzhao Mansion in the same year." Magistrate Zhu said: "The son takes the blame for the father, and the father's debt is paid by the son. Although he is a nephew, the principle is the same."
Chief Xu took a breath: "After the incident, Xu Qian should be locked up in the government prison. How did he do it?"
Magistrate Zhu pondered: "I thought it was incredible at first, but now I understand."
Chief Xu also thought about it and couldn't believe it: "Only based on the files?!"
Just based on the files... Mr. Wang was at a loss. He could occasionally hear the secrets of this kind of officialdom from the three officials above him.
What he couldn't believe was that Xu Qi'an exerted tremendous energy in the tax bank robbery and rescued the Xu family.
Wang Baotou thought, "This is wrong, it doesn't make sense."
When this kid first arrived, he had a simple and stubborn personality, and he could only do things in a dull manner. He was a real fool.
How could such a stupid guy solve the case so quickly?
...
When Capt. Wang took the cards and returned to the lounge, Xu Qian fell asleep on the table. He thought too much about the messy things last night and didn't go to bed until after the third watch.
Others reached out to push Xu Qian, but Wang Captou immediately stopped him and lowered his voice: "Let him sleep."
He picked two people at random and said, "You guys come with me to Zhang's house."
The three quick hands and their respective white servants, a total of nine people, quickly left the Changle County Government Office.
White laborers are temporary workers, a type of corvée, made up of ordinary people, who receive no wages and are not provided with food or housing.
But there is also a very conscientious part: they don’t have to take the blame.
Xu Qian was awakened by the "powerful" voice, wiped the saliva from the corner of his mouth, and walked to the county government lobby.
It is estimated that the person has been arrested and the county magistrate is interrogating him in front of the court.
In the court, Magistrate Zhu stood behind the public case, surrounded by court officials and followers.
Under the public case, there were three squads of government officials standing on the left and right sides, and two people were kneeling in the middle. One was a young man wearing a blue robe embroidered with cloud patterns, and the other was a beautiful woman wearing a purple skirt.
The woman looked frightened, but the young man was relatively calm.
"Crack!"
Magistrate Zhu angrily slapped the wooden door in the hall and said loudly: "Who is this person in the hall?"
The woman glanced at the young man subconsciously. The young man gave her a calm look and straightened his back: "Zhang Xian, a common man."
The woman said in a soft voice: "Mr. Yang Zhenzhen, a civilian woman."
Magistrate Zhu shouted: "How did you two kill Zhang Yourui? Let's face it!"
The woman trembled in fright, her long eyelashes trembling, and her face showed fear.
The young man Zhang Xian was shocked: "Why would you say this, sir? How could a common man kill his biological father?"
Magistrate Zhu asked: "Where were you when the incident happened?"
"I'm in the study."
"ForWhy not collapse with your wife? "
“The grassroots are looking at the accounts. "
"There are witnesses. "
"How can I get a witness in the middle of the night? "
Zhang Xian's answer was clear and unhurried. Either he had a clear conscience or he had already drafted it.
Based on his own logical reasoning, Xu Qi'an preferred the latter possibility.
Although he has no alibi, there is also no evidence to prove that he committed the murder. Reasoning follows reasoning. If there is no tangible evidence, there will be no suspicion...
The county magistrate turned to the woman and said, "Ms. Zhang Yang, I want to ask you, you have been married to Zhang Yourui for ten years and have nothing to do. Why am I pregnant again now? Tell me honestly, did you murder your husband by living with your stepson? "
Zhang Yang was startled and cried: "Sir, the civilian woman has been wronged. The civilian woman is in poor health. She has been recovering every day in recent years and finally became pregnant with her husband's flesh and blood. How can you use this to accuse the civilian woman of murdering her husband?" "
He cried loudly.
How could such an interrogation reveal the truth? Xu Qian looked at the Shui Ling woman from a distance for a moment, and then he had a good idea.
